in_sanskrit.name: अकुल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One whose mind is always absorbed in a single thought or task. Derived from the root 'ku' meaning 'to dry up' and the prefix 'a' meaning 'not'. The name signifies someone whose mind is never dry or exhausted, always full of enthusiasm and focus.

in_hindi.name: अकुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Alone, isolated, solitary, secluded. The name Akul can also be derived from the Sanskrit word 'akula' meaning 'inexhaustible', which signifies someone who is always filled with energy and enthusiasm.

in_tamil.name: Akul
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Immortal, undying
in_tamil.long_meaning: Akul ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। In Sanskrit, Akul means 'immortal' or 'undying'. Derived from the root word 'akula', which means 'deathless'. This name is associated with eternal life and invincibility, as well as the strength and courage needed to overcome obstacles.
